label: sdc01_0130_brother_01
text: This is the Festival of Masks! Today’s just the first\nday. It’ll keep going for a while...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_01
text: I bet you don’t have any festivals this big over\nin Paldea or wherever, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_select_01
text: That’s true!

label: sdc01_0130_sister_02
text: Heh... Knew it. See, Kitakami’s just as good as\nany of your big, shiny cities.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_03
text: Oh no! Guess it’s so incredible you’re at a loss\nfor words, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_brother_02
text: It’s OK, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Just ignore her...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_11
text: I’ll snap a photo so you can remember this\namazing night forever.\c\nGimme your Roto-Stick for a sec...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_13
text: C’mon, you two. Scooch in closer![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_brother_07
text: Ow! You’re steppin’ on my toe, Sis![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_14
text: Oh, stop complaining! This’ll only take a second![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_15
text: OK, are you all ready? Say Chansey![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_12
text: Now that’s what I call a nice festival vibe![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_04
text: The Festival of Masks is held so we can all honor\nthe [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Loyal Three[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], the brave heroes of Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_05
text: The Loyal Three are the Pokémon that once\nprotected this land from the evil ogre, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_06
text: Most of the kids in town wear masks of the Loyal\nThree, like me. Did I mention they’re our heroes?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_07
text: What? What’re you laughin’ at?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_brother_04
text: N-nothin’! I was just thinkin’ it was funny that,\nlike...you don’t know anything about the ogre...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_08
text: What?! I know the legends of Kitakami better\nthan anybody!\c\nPretty gutsy of you to laugh at your big sis![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_09
text: Kiki’s still a little baby, so of course he thinks\nsome kind of terrible monster’s cool. He likes\r\nthe ogre more than the Loyal Three.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_brother_06
text: Oh, look! They’ve got candy apples! Let’s go\ncheck out the stalls![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0130_sister_10
text: That brother of mine’s awfully quick to run away\nwhen he doesn’t like what’s being said.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0130_stopper_01
text: You should check out the festival before you go!

label: sdc01_0130_brother_stop
text: H-heeey! Over here![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
